comparisons.peer_summary: All Other operating loss was $4.2 billion in 2024 and $4.4 billion in 2023, primarily consisting of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and stock-based compensation expense.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and AMD both report on the operating results of their 'All Other' segment. Intel discloses 'All other operating expenses' of $2.1 billion, roughly flat year-over-year. AMD discloses an 'All Other operating loss' of $4.2 billion, which is broken down into amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ($2.4 billion) and stock-based compensation expense ($1.4 billion). While Intel presents a net expense figure without this specific breakdown in the selected text, AMD's disclosure provides a more granular view of the 'All Other' losses driven by acquisition amortization and compensation, contrasting with Intel's stable total expense figure.
